description: [builtin] Answer from TRUSTED sources only (Wikipedia, Wikidata, arXiv, Crossref/DOI, World Bank): returns passages with URL, reliability tier and retrieval time for citation. With synthesize=true you also get an LLM answer that cites the passages and admits when they don't contain the answer. (costs $0.01 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

language.description: Wikipedia language edition (en, es, de, fr, pt, ...)

synthesize.description: Return a cited answer synthesized by an LLM (when the server has an LLM key)

name: trusted_lookup
